o.text: From Proto-Turkic *Kur- (“to erect (a building), to establish”). Cognate with Turkish kurmak, etc.

Possibly from Proto-Common Turkic *bayïr. Cognate with Turkish bayır (“hill”), Turkmen baýyr (“hill”), Khakas паар (paar, “foot-hill”), Yakut быар (bïar, “hummock”), Crimean Tatar and Gagauz bayır (“mountain”). Compare Mongolian байр (bair, “place”).
Borrowed from Russian дерматология (dermatologija). By surface analysis, dermato- + -logiya.
